Nvidia Reinstates CEO Jensen Huang After Resignation

Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, president, and board director, effective immediately. The decision followed his resignation on November 12, with his return announced on November 23. The company's board voted unanimously to bring Huang back after a national security review, stating they were confident he posed no risk. Huang expressed his honor at returning and his eagerness to get back to work, describing the moment as the start of a new industrial revolution. His initial resignation came after reports of extramarital affairs, including allegations of a relationship with a Chinese spy, which were investigated.
